title: Reproducibility review of: Food Insecurity Projections for Anticipatory Action: A Comparative Spatiotemporal Analysis of FEWS NET and the IPC in Somalia
description: The article presents a comparative spatio-temporal analysis of food insecurity projections in Somalia. A workflow is provided as a collection of scripts and the environment is a Docker compose configuration. This workflow as described could be executed and all figures and maps from the article were recreated with the code and data provided. **The reproduction is fully successful.**
